scope: Calls of $T procedures deduce bindings and get one checked instance per (procedure, bindings): a pristine copy of the template's parsed signature and body, cloned before checking and checked under the bindings. Instances are evaluated, emitted under their own C names, tested, covered and mutated like concrete procedures.

new_rules: CK_templates / CK_clone: pristine copies of procedures with $T in a parameter type, made before any check

CK_instance: argument count (E0316), deduction (CK_bind: E0348 bound twice, E0349 not a view, E0397 no value), concrete parameters (CK_argument, E0317), sharing by CK_same, budget of 256 instances (E0339), result by CK_subst
calls inside a generic body make symbolic (never expanded) instances
CK_instantiate / CK_expand: after the checks, each instance resolves and checks its own copy; its calls may add instances
CK_key / CK_mangle: length-prefixed binding names for C
CK_reach marks the template when a check reaches an instance (#authority coverage)
CK_metal checks each instance's signature and body
checker.checks: 596 checks, 596 passed (fixtures generated from real parser output plus unit #test/#forall)

kernels.seeds: bootstrap/checker.{c,h} regenerated with the trusted 0.34.0 compiler after the checks and mutation passed; coax/build.sh bootstrapped 0.35.0 from it

native_transport: src/check.cpp: ProcDecl/Param/Stmt objects for checker-made nodes; instances follow the authored procedures in File::procs and copy the template's span, authority and root_source
src/emit_c.cpp: an instance's C name is its template's + '__' + key
src/main.cpp: declarations, references and lowering records skip instances; --timings reports instances and instance_generated_bytes

covers: int, f64 and struct/enum programs print the same results natively at -O0 and -O2 and through #run and coax test
14 instances under their own C names; --timings counts them and their bytes
deps --declarations lists templates once; references point at templates
#authority coverage through instances; coax mutate runs over instance bodies
